summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Leverage Shares 100% TSLA AND 100% SPCX Daily ETF (ELOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed fund, attempting to leverage daily exposure 100% to Tesla and 100% to SpaceX stocks. The ETF uses swaps and other derivatives to create the exposure, resetting each trading day. ELOL was launched on Jul 30, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
